name: playwise
description: PlayWise — gaming deals, tournaments & news aggregator. Monorepo: React/Vite frontend + Express/Prisma backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
